_comment: Example showing how to mix traditional OGG files with external URL music

tracks._comment: Traditional OGG file from resource pack

_notes: You can mix OGG files (using 'sound' field) and external URLs (using 'external_url' field) in the same resource pack
The priority system works the same for both types
External URL tracks are downloaded and cached on first use
Backward compatibility is maintained - existing resource packs continue to work without modification
